title: A Kitchen for the Summer
author: Vesper Marchetti
blurb: Ulyana Vane, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
